sloka: स मातरम् चैव विसम्ज्ञकल्पा ।मार्तम् च सौमित्रि मभिप्रतप्तम् ।धर्मे स्थितो धर्म्यमुवाच वाक्यम् ।यथा स एवार्हति तत्र वक्तुम् ॥२-२१-५४॥
transliteration: sa mātaram caiva visamjñakalpā ।mārtam ca saumitri mabhiprataptam ।dharme sthito dharmyamuvāca vākyam ।yathā sa evārhati tatra vaktum ॥2-21-54॥

translations.english: Rama, centred on righteousness, again addressed his mother who had almost fainted and Lakshmana who was deeply distressed. As his words were consistent with righteousness, he alone was competent to speak that way.
